subject: Activation matrix: schema gating and live tool-call readiness
messages:
From: Emily Yang <emily@somahq.com>
To: jonas_weber
Date: 2026-09-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation plan questions — structured output

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the live output and tool-calling looked promising. Our engineering lead asked for one thing before we lock dates: a clear activation matrix that ties schema gating (JSON output validation), streaming readiness, and tool-call fallbacks to specific milestone owners. Can you put together a short MOP (mutual operational plan) that maps checkpoints to who on Redwood and who on our side owns the gate?

We'd like the plan to include:
- simple pass/fail schema validation for structured outputs
- how streaming fallback to polling works if KV cache warms slowly
- tool-call idempotency expectations and retry behavior

Attachments: none from me.

Appreciate it — Emily
Emily Yang
Head of Product, SomaHealth
emily@somahq.com

From: jonas_weber
To: Emily Yang <emily@somahq.com>
Cc: monica_patel, kimberly_park
Date: 2026-09-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation plan questions — structured output

Emily — thanks for the clear ask. Monica and Kim, looping you both in to own pieces of the MOP.

High level: I've attached a draft activation matrix (SOMA_activation_matrix_v1.xlsx) and a reference schema file (soma_live_schema_v1.json). Draft covers the three checkpoints Emily listed plus rollout gates for canary -> full. Key owners:
- Schema gating & acceptance tests: Soma Eng (primary), Redwood QA (secondary)
- Streaming readiness & perf SLO: Redwood runtime (Monica)
- Tool-call reliability & idempotency: Redwood integration (Kim)

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Jonas to circulate draft MOP and schema (attached) — by EOD 9/13
2) Soma to run schema acceptance tests against a small test corpus and share results (target 9/14)
3) Joint run of a streaming pilot (10K tokens) with tool-call toggles on 9/16
4) Canary -> full rollout after acceptance — owner signoffs recorded in the MOP and DocuSign where required

Also linking a short runbook excerpt in the attached doc for how we fallback from streaming to short-polling (3s polling window) and how we surface idempotency tokens for tool-calls.

Let me know if we should add a compliance checkpoint (SOC 2 evidence) — I can bring our security PM into the thread.

Attachment stubs: SOMA_activation_matrix_v1.xlsx, soma_live_schema_v1.json

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.inference

From: monica_patel
To: jonas_weber, kimberly_park
Date: 2026-09-14T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Activation plan questions — structured output

Quick internal sync before we send the refined MOP to Soma: a few notes from an ops perspective —
- Streaming pilot: recommend we enable prefix caching and a 5-token lookahead on the pilot to reduce cold-start regressions. Will monitor tail latency.
- Polling fallback: propose default 3s poll with exponential backoff capped at 30s; log telemetry to a joint S3 bucket for 30 days.
- Schema gating: we'll provide a lightweight npm tool to run JSON schema validation locally against the sample corpus; Kim, can we snapshot the schema validator container and include it in the MOP?

I can own the streaming readiness milestone and the telemetry config. Plan to publish the telemetry dashboard link into the shared Drive folder after pilot.

-Monica
Director, Customer Success Operations
monica@redwood.inference

From: kimberly_park
To: Emily Yang <emily@somahq.com>, jonas_weber, monica_patel
Date: 2026-09-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Activation plan questions — structured output

Emily — quick note on tool-calls and idempotency:
- We'll attach an idempotency-key header to every tool invocation; retries will be safe for idempotent operations.
- Non-idempotent operations will be routed to a protected queue and require a single-confirmation toggle from your side (we can add a UI flag in the pilot).
- We'll include a small contract document in the MOP that spells out error codes, retry policy, and the observable points (request-id, idempotency-key).

Attaching: mutual_action_plan.docx (draft)

If this looks good I'll fold these into the activation matrix and send a versioned MOP to Emily with signoff placeholders for your PMs.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.inference

From: Emily Yang <emily@somahq.com>
To: jonas_weber, kimberly_park, monica_patel
Date: 2026-09-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation plan questions — structured output

Thanks team — this is exactly what we needed. Two quick asks before the pilot on 9/16:
1) Can you add a simple pass/fail column in the activation matrix for our security checklist (SOC 2 evidence: change logs for schema changes)?
2) Shared S3 bucket permissions: can your ops team provision read/write for eng@somahq.com?

If you can get an updated MOP with those two items by EOD 9/15 we can confirm the 9/16 pilot. If not, we may need to push one day.

I'll confirm internally as soon as I get the updated doc.

Best,
Emily
Head of Product, SomaHealth
